settings.enableVanillaQuickRoll.name: Use Vanilla Rolls with RSReforged Styling
settings.enableVanillaQuickRoll.hint: Retired in the GMC fork: Shift-click shows the dnd5e dialogs while keeping the one-card result.
settings.enableAbilityQuickRoll.name: Enable Quick Roll for Abilities
settings.enableAbilityQuickRoll.hint: Ability checks and saving throws (including death saves and save request buttons) skip the dnd5e roll dialog. Hold the dnd5e 'Skip Dialog' key (Shift by default) to show the dialog instead.
settings.enableSkillQuickRoll.name: Enable Quick Roll for Skills
settings.enableSkillQuickRoll.hint: Skill checks skip the dnd5e roll dialog. Hold the dnd5e 'Skip Dialog' key (Shift by default) to show the dialog instead.
settings.enableToolQuickRoll.name: Enable Quick Roll for Tool Checks
settings.enableToolQuickRoll.hint: Tool checks skip the dnd5e roll dialog. Hold the dnd5e 'Skip Dialog' key (Shift by default) to show the dialog instead.
settings.enableActivityQuickRoll.name: Enable Quick Roll for Activities
settings.enableActivityQuickRoll.hint: Using an activity rolls its attack, damage, healing or formula straight onto one usage card. Hold the dnd5e 'Skip Dialog' key (Shift by default) to show the usage, attack and damage dialogs — the results still land on the same single card.
settings.alwaysRollMulti.name: Always Roll Two d20s (Multiroll)
settings.alwaysRollMulti.hint: Every normal d20 roll rolls a second d20 up-front (the first one counts), so advantage or disadvantage can be applied afterwards from the roll's breakdown without rolling again. The ignored die is shown dimmed.
settings.manualDamageMode.name: Roll Damage Manually
settings.manualDamageMode.hint: Do not roll damage automatically. The card keeps dnd5e's Damage button; clicking it rolls the damage onto the same card.
settings.aggregateDamage.name: Aggregate Damage Fields
settings.aggregateDamage.hint: When outputting a quick roll, combine all damage fields of the same type into a single field.
settings.enableD20Icons.name: Show Natural d20 on Rolls
settings.enableD20Icons.hint: Show the natural d20 result (and the ignored multiroll die) on the right of a d20 roll's total.
settings.hideNpcRollMode.name: Hide NPC Roll Results
settings.hideNpcRollMode.hint: For quick rolls made by actors a player does not own, hide the modified total and modifiers so only the natural d20 result is visible. Damage and healing totals are always shown. GMs and actor owners always see full results.
settings.hideNpcRollStyle.name: Hidden Roll Style
settings.hideNpcRollStyle.hint: Controls what is masked when an NPC roll is hidden (see Hide NPC Roll Results). 'Hide Total' masks the modified total and shows the natural d20. 'Hide Breakdown' reveals the final total but masks the natural d20 value and all modifiers.
settings.enableHideFinalResult.name: Hide Result of NPC Attacks (Legacy)
settings.enableHideFinalResult.hint: Legacy setting preserved for older worlds. Use Hide NPC Roll Results instead.
settings.enableDiceReroll.name: Enable Dice Rerolling
settings.enableDiceReroll.hint: When outputting a quick roll, enable the ability to click a specific die in the chat message tooltip to reroll that die in place.
settings.enableOverlayButtons.name: Retroactive Roll Buttons
settings.enableOverlayButtons.hint: Show Disadvantage / Normal / Advantage buttons on d20 rolls and a Critical button on RSReforged damage inside a roll's breakdown (click the roll total). The '+ Bonus' button is always available to the roll's owner.
settings.damageApplyMode.name: Damage Apply UI
settings.damageApplyMode.hint: Retired in the GMC fork: damage is always applied with dnd5e's native tray.
settings.enableDamageButtons.name: Enable Damage Apply Buttons (Legacy)
settings.enableDamageButtons.hint: Legacy setting preserved for older worlds. Use Damage Apply UI instead.
settings.alwaysShowButtons.name: Always Show RSReforged Apply Buttons
settings.applyDamageTo.name: RSReforged Apply Button Targets
settings.confirmRetroAdv.name: Confirm Retroactive Advantage
settings.confirmRetroAdv.hint: Show a confirmation dialog when retroactively changing a roll to advantage or disadvantage.
settings.confirmRetroCrit.name: Confirm Retroactive Crits
settings.confirmRetroCrit.hint: Show a confirmation dialog when retroactively changing a roll to critical damage.
settings.rerollEveryone.name: Enable Interactive Dice (Master Switch)
settings.rerollEveryone.hint: Master switch for clickable dice rerolling and GM fudging. If disabled, no one can reroll dice by clicking, regardless of the per-role settings below.
settings.rerollPlayers.name: Allow Players to Reroll Their Own Dice
settings.rerollPlayers.hint: If enabled, players can left-click any die in the chat tooltip of a roll they made to reroll that die in place. GMs can always reroll any die.
settings.fudgeGM.name: Allow GM Dice Fudging
settings.fudgeGM.hint: If enabled, the GM can right-click any die in the chat tooltip to manually set its result via a prompt.
settings.rerollSoundEnabled.name: Reroll Sound & Dice So Nice
settings.rerollSoundEnabled.hint: When a die is rerolled, play the configured dice sound and animate the rerolled die in 3D via Dice So Nice if installed. If Dice So Nice is not available, the dice sound is still played as a fallback.
settings.rerollLogChat.name: Log Rerolls to Chat
settings.rerollLogChat.hint: When a die is rerolled, post a public chat message announcing the reroll (e.g. "Alice rerolled a d20: 7 → 14"). The message respects the current roll mode (public/whisper/blind/self).
settings.fastForwardRolls.name: Fast-Forward Rolls (Shift to Configure)
settings.fastForwardRolls.hint: Inverts dnd5e's dialog key for every roll that goes through the dnd5e roll pipeline and has no explicit dialog choice (card buttons, save request buttons, hit dice, initiative, ...): rolls skip the configuration dialog unless the dnd5e 'Skip Dialog' key (Shift by default) is held. Alt/Ctrl keep their dnd5e meaning (advantage/disadvantage, critical/normal damage). dnd5e has no built-in setting for this. Activity, ability, skill and tool rolls follow the 'Enable Quick Roll' toggles.
settings.hidePrivateRolls.name: Hide Private Rolls Completely
settings.hidePrivateRolls.hint: GM, blind and self rolls are hidden completely from players who may not see them: no '???' placeholder card and no line in a usage card's save/check summary. The GM can reveal such a message to everyone with the eye button in its header (or on its summary line).
settings.debug.name: Debug Logging
settings.debug.hint: Log RSReforged decisions (fast-forward, multiroll, card processing) to the browser console. Also see game.modules.get('rsreforged').api.debug.

versatileTwoHanded.name: Use Versatile Two-Handed
versatileTwoHanded.hint: Hold this key when clicking a Versatile weapon attack (longsword, quarterstaff, etc.) to roll it two-handed. Default: V. Releases automatically after the click — no toggle to remember. Has no effect on non-Versatile weapons.

buttons.damageFull: Click to apply full damage to selected token(s).
buttons.damageHalf: Click to apply half damage to selected token(s).
buttons.damageQuarter: Click to apply quarter damage to selected token(s).
buttons.damageDouble: Click to apply double damage to selected token(s).
buttons.healing: Click to apply healing to selected token(s).
buttons.healingTemp: Click to apply temporary hitpoints to selected token(s).
buttons.rollAdvantage: Switch to advantage (uses the second d20)
buttons.rollDisadvantage: Switch to disadvantage (uses the second d20)
buttons.repeat: Click to repeat the quick roll.
buttons.damageType: Click to change the damage type.
buttons.bonus: Add a retroactive bonus to this roll
buttons.rollNormal: Switch to a normal roll (first d20)

tray.quarter: Apply a quarter of the damage
tray.tempHp: Apply the total as temporary hit points
